probes.check: verify checks each recorded step against the phase Jolt's lifecycle facts declare.

seeded_violation.description: Install a Jolt trace hook and record Jolt's Trace+AssertFailed step from setup glue, in the systems phase.

probes.check: am_jolt_setup_init() calls JPH::VerifyJoltVersionID(), which compares the version and ABI defines the glue compiled with against the library's, before RegisterTypes() would abort on a mismatch; the failure is recorded first.

seeded_violation.description: Define JPH_CROSS_PLATFORM_DETERMINISTIC for the glue in Jolt's build fragment, while the joltphysics port is built without it.

adaptation_notes: The build fragment calls find_package(Jolt CONFIG REQUIRED), links Jolt::Jolt, and compiles the glue with -fno-rtti (MSVC /GR-), since glue derives from Jolt classes and the port builds Jolt without RTTI.

Setup glue checks JPH::VerifyJoltVersionID(), runs Factory and RegisterTypes, then creates one PhysicsSystem with two object layers (non-moving, moving) mapped to two broad-phase layers and a TempAllocatorImpl. The jolt--jobs binding provides the job system the game passes to PhysicsSystem::Update.
The layer tables and capacities are placeholders the game replaces; setup glue creates no bodies.
Shutdown destroys the PhysicsSystem before UnregisterTypes and deleting the Factory.
